queries.title: Scope and missing data
queries.method: Full filtered snapshot. Missing and unparseable periods remain in the coverage count but are excluded from time comparisons.
queries.sql: WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "group" AS "source: group", "year" AS "source: year", "amount" AS "source: amount", "phase" AS "source: phase", CAST("group" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CASE WHEN REGEXP_FULL_MATCH(TRIM(CAST("year" AS VARCHAR)), '[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4}') THEN TRY_CAST("year" AS INTEGER) END AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_fixture" WHERE CAST("phase" AS VARCHAR) = 'adopted') SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT("source: amount") AS reported_values, COUNT(*) - COUNT("source: amount") AS missing_values, MIN("source: amount") AS minimum, MEDIAN("source: amount") AS median, MAX("source: amount") AS maximum, COUNT(*) - COUNT(discovery_period) AS unusable_period_rows, MIN(discovery_period) AS first_period, MAX(discovery_period) AS last_period FROM analysis_scope

queries.title: Column quality
queries.method: Null counts, distinct reported values, and range over every filtered row. Text suppression markers remain distinct values; a nonmissing cell is not necessarily a usable measurement.
queries.sql:
SELECT 'group' AS column_name, 'TEXT' AS logical_type, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT("group") AS missing_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "group") AS distinct_values, CAST(MIN("group") AS VARCHAR) AS minimum, CAST(MAX("group") AS VARCHAR) AS maximum FROM "analysis_fixture" WHERE CAST("phase" AS VARCHAR) = 'adopted'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'year' AS column_name, 'TEXT' AS logical_type, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT("year") AS missing_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "year") AS distinct_values, CAST(MIN("year") AS VARCHAR) AS minimum, CAST(MAX("year") AS VARCHAR) AS maximum FROM "analysis_fixture" WHERE CAST("phase" AS VARCHAR) = 'adopted'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'amount' AS column_name, 'INTEGER' AS logical_type, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT("amount") AS missing_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "amount") AS distinct_values, CAST(MIN("amount") AS VARCHAR) AS minimum, CAST(MAX("amount") AS VARCHAR) AS maximum FROM "analysis_fixture" WHERE CAST("phase" AS VARCHAR) = 'adopted'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'phase' AS column_name, 'TEXT' AS logical_type, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT("phase") AS missing_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "phase") AS distinct_values, CAST(MIN("phase") AS VARCHAR) AS minimum, CAST(MAX("phase") AS VARCHAR) AS maximum FROM "analysis_fixture" WHERE CAST("phase" AS VARCHAR) = 'adopted'

queries.title: Differences by group
queries.method: Sum of reported values per group across all selected periods. Record share uses ALL filtered rows as denominator, including missing groups. Missing measurements are shown separately; observed values may be incomplete.
queries.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "group" AS "source: group", "year" AS "source: year", "amount" AS "source: amount", "phase" AS "source: phase", CAST("group" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CASE WHEN REGEXP_FULL_MATCH(TRIM(CAST("year" AS VARCHAR)), '[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4}') THEN TRY_CAST("year" AS INTEGER) END AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_fixture" WHERE CAST("phase" AS VARCHAR) = 'adopted'), analysis_groups AS (
  SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT("source: amount") AS missing_values, SUM("source: amount") AS observed_value
  FROM analysis_scope GROUP BY discovery_group
) SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * source_rows / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows) OVER (), 0), 2) AS record_share_percent
FROM analysis_groups ORDER BY ABS(observed_value) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST

queries.title: Largest changes over time
queries.method: Adjacent observed periods within the same group. Missing intervening periods and missing measurements suppress differences. A zero baseline suppresses percentage change. Partial period coverage and changing populations require review.
queries.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "group" AS "source: group", "year" AS "source: year", "amount" AS "source: amount", "phase" AS "source: phase", CAST("group" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CASE WHEN REGEXP_FULL_MATCH(TRIM(CAST("year" AS VARCHAR)), '[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4}') THEN TRY_CAST("year" AS INTEGER) END AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_fixture" WHERE CAST("phase" AS VARCHAR) = 'adopted'), analysis_periods AS (
 SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, discovery_period, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT("source: amount") AS missing_values, SUM("source: amount") AS observed_value
 FROM analysis_scope WHERE discovery_period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY discovery_group, discovery_period
), analysis_previous AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(discovery_period) OVER w AS previous_period, LAG(observed_value) OVER w AS previous_value,
 LAG(source_rows) OVER w AS previous_rows, LAG(missing_values) OVER w AS previous_missing_values
 FROM analysis_periods WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY group_value ORDER BY discovery_period)
), analysis_changes AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_period IS NULL THEN 'No baseline' WHEN discovery_period - previous_period <> 1 THEN 'Missing intervening periods'
 WHEN missing_values > 0 OR previous_missing_values > 0 THEN 'Incomplete measurements' ELSE 'Adjacent periods with reported values' END AS comparison_status
 FROM analysis_previous
)
SELECT *, CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN observed_value - previous_value END AS change,
 CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN ROUND(100.0 * (observed_value - previous_value) / NULLIF(ABS(previous_value), 0), 2) END AS change_percent
FROM analysis_changes ORDER BY ABS(change) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST, discovery_period

queries.title: Unusual source values
queries.method: Values outside Q1 − 1.5 × IQR or Q3 + 1.5 × IQR within the selected group and period. At least eight reported values and a positive IQR are required. These are review leads, not evidence of error or wrongdoing. Quartiles use observed values (discrete quantiles).
queries.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "group" AS "source: group", "year" AS "source: year", "amount" AS "source: amount", "phase" AS "source: phase", CAST("group" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CASE WHEN REGEXP_FULL_MATCH(TRIM(CAST("year" AS VARCHAR)), '[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4}') THEN TRY_CAST("year" AS INTEGER) END AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_fixture" WHERE CAST("phase" AS VARCHAR) = 'adopted'), analysis_distribution AS (
 SELECT *, COUNT("source: amount") OVER w AS peer_values, QUANTILE_DISC("source: amount", 0.25) OVER w AS q1,
 QUANTILE_DISC("source: amount", 0.75) OVER w AS q3
 FROM analysis_scope WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY discovery_group, discovery_period)
), analysis_unusual AS (
 SELECT *, q1 - 1.5 * (q3 - q1) AS lower_fence, q3 + 1.5 * (q3 - q1) AS upper_fence
 FROM analysis_distribution WHERE peer_values >= 8 AND q3 > q1 AND discovery_period IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_flagged_rows FROM analysis_unusual
WHERE "source: amount" < lower_fence OR "source: amount" > upper_fence
ORDER BY ABS("source: amount") DESC

queries.title: Repeated source rows
queries.method: Exact row-hash repeats across the entire snapshot, including rows outside the selected filters. They are not removed automatically: repeated records can be legitimate. Original row numbers and source cells are retained for review.
queries.sql:
SELECT row_hash, COUNT(*) AS occurrences, MIN(row_number) AS first_source_row, MAX(row_number) AS last_source_row,
 MIN(source_payload_json) AS source_cells FROM analytical_rows
WHERE snapshot_id = 'fixture' AND malformed = 0
GROUP BY row_hash HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY occurrences DESC, first_source_row
